Stellar picked Zebec as its global stable
policy.description:
🚨🚨🚨 This partnership changes the game for $ZBCN and $XLM.

Stellar picked Zebec as its global stablecoin payroll provider. First time Zebec's streaming infrastructure goes native outside Solana. 

Salaries streamed per second in USDC on Stellar. MoneyGram handles the cash-out at 450,000+ locations in 170+ countries.

For XLM, it adds massive real-world utility. Every streamed salary is a transaction on Stellar. 

Every MoneyGram conversion touches the network. Payroll is recurring, consistent volume that compounds.

For ZBCN, it validates the protocol beyond one chain. Stellar didn't just partner with Zebec. They selected them. 

The Stellar Development Foundation chose this infrastructure specifically for global payroll.

Zebec is also Nacha-integrated, ISO 20022 compliant, and connected to the $85 trillion US ACH network. The traditional finance rails are already plugged in.

$ZBCN is the engine. $XLM is the highway. The traffic is about to flow.

Solana News from Yesterday

- Ondo Finance added 50+ new stocks and ETFs to its tokenized offerings on Solana, bringing its total listings on Ondo Global Markets to over 250.

- Anchorage Digital launched Atlas Collateral Management with Kamino pilot on Solana

- Alchemy introduced x402 support on Solana, allowing agents to access its APIs with pay-as-you-go USDC payments without accounts or signups.

- Ranger finance completed a second audit of its core vault program by Web3 security firm Certora

- Gusto now supports same day USDC payouts for international contractors, including direct payments to Solana wallets.

- GhostLogs unveiled new validator scorecard

- Colosseum announced winners of its Solana Agent Hackathon: DegenDomeSolana, AgentOS by 0xbraindeds, and Blockhelix

- Solana Mobile launched Builder Grants to fund apps, tools, and SKR-integrated products.

- FairScale introduced L3Ns on Google Chrome, allowing users to instantly view a Solana wallet’s FairScore anywhere on the internet.

- YO introduced yoSOL, an automated SOL vault that rebalances across Solana DeFi to optimize yield.

- Messari expands x402 payments to Solana.
- Superteam Germany announced Solana Summit in Berlin.

- Metaplex introduced 014 Agent Registry on Solana.

- Forward Industries funded $27.4M share buyback with Galaxy-backed Solana loan

- Jupiter launched pre-IPO trading with limit orders on PreStocks.
